Subject: Intimation of Earnings Call with Investors/Analysts for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Company 
will be conducting an Earnings Call with Investors/Analysts to discuss the financial results of the 
Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 on November 3, 2026 at 02.00 p.m 
(IST). 
Dial-in details are enclosed in the annexure. 
The details of the call will also be posted on the Company’s website at https://www.kanohar.com. 
This is for your information and records.
